constraints: one active capability crown per lane
Claude Code is not standing authority
stop on evidence or authority failure

calculus.AdmittedObservation: aligned grounded observation accepted for manufacture
calculus.Receipt: identity-bound evidence of authority and consequence
calculus.Replay: independent reproduction against the same identities
calculus.Standing: scoped verdict over exact subject and evidence

production_lane.takt: one independently accepted capability per sustainable interval

naming.law: first letter of subject plus first three letters of operation

first_crown.demand: convert a bounded design conversation into a canonical zero-gap production package
first_crown.consequence: deterministic Claude, Toyota, Genesis, PPDDL, Hygen, schema, receipt, and replay projections

concepts.label: Chatman Equation
concepts.summary: A = μ(O*) and R = receipt(A); admitted observation precedes lawful manufacture.

decision.acceptance: calculus contains all nine canonical objects
decision.falsifier: actuation occurs before admission or without receipt

concepts.label: Combinatorial Maximalism
concepts.summary: Preserve the maximum bounded reversible possibility space before irreversible selection.

decision.acceptance: reversible alternatives remain represented until an admitted selection
decision.falsifier: a lawful alternative is destroyed before selection

concepts.label: Combinatorial Minimalism
concepts.summary: After admission, choose the smallest sufficient lawful path to terminal standing.

decision.acceptance: one WIP-limited path closes all obligations
decision.falsifier: removable work remains in the selected path

concepts.label: Toyota Code Production System
concepts.summary: Pull-based one-piece capability flow with WIP limits, jidoka, andon, receipts, and independent acceptance.

decision.acceptance: WIP limit is one and completion requires receipt plus replay
decision.falsifier: a second crown enters the lane before terminal standing

concepts.label: Claude Code Reference Operator
concepts.summary: Claude reconstructs, challenges, and iterates system understanding without ambient actuation or self-certification.

decision.acceptance: generated agents, skills, settings, and hook preserve role boundaries
decision.falsifier: Claude receives ambient actuation or standing authority

concepts.label: Multilingual Typed Protocol
concepts.summary: Chinese tokens type planning, Japanese tokens type standardized automation, Korean tokens type bounded execution, and explicit tokens type verification and stop.

decision.acceptance: all five canonical symbols have non-overlapping authority and outputs
decision.falsifier: one namespace silently inherits another authority

concepts.label: Genesis Naming and CLI Law
concepts.summary: Observe, distinguish, identify invariants, then derive a four-character CLI token using first-letter plus first-three-letter compression.

decision.acceptance: all canonical tokens equal the 1+3 function and have no collisions
decision.falsifier: a token is invented independently or collides

concepts.label: PPDDL Refactor Planner
concepts.summary: Represent the restart as bounded capability states, actions, costs, WIP, verification, and closure goals.

decision.acceptance: domain and problem close every concept while minimizing action cost
decision.falsifier: the plan permits concurrent WIP or unreceipted completion

concepts.label: Hygen Bootstrap Lower Bound
concepts.summary: Use discover, route, bind, render, and write to scaffold the minimum self-hosting successor, then retire Hygen from production.

decision.acceptance: five bootstrap surfaces and four retirement predicates are generated
decision.falsifier: Hygen owns semantic authority or remains a runtime dependency

concepts.label: Twelve-Step Vibecoding Boundary
concepts.summary: Canonical Workaholics Anonymous Steps remain external authority; machines cannot sponsor, diagnose, amend, or certify recovery.

decision.acceptance: privacy and non-diagnosis refusals remain explicit
decision.falsifier: a machine is assigned sponsor, diagnosis, amend, or recovery-certification authority

concepts.label: First Reference Capability Crown
concepts.summary: One customer capability flows from demand through admission, planning, manufacture, bounded actuation, receipt, replay, and standing.

decision.falsifier: any gap remains or second manufacture differs
